summary: Iter51 tested GET /api/drivers/my-active-rewards + driver-side conditional UI (Recompenses button on /chauffeur/home, 'Programme de recompense' row in /chauffeur/profile, /chauffeur/rewards page with vehicle_rewards + guarantees + eligibility). Backend: 14/14 pytest GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_iter51_active_rewards.py covering: unauthenticated 401, admin (non-driver) 404, response shape (vehicle_rewards/guarantees/any_active/driver_vehicle_type/driver_acceptance_rate/driver_cancellation_rate/checked_at), car driver matches 'Voiture' and not 'Moto' (fuzzy match), inactive regard excluded, future start_date excluded, past end_date excluded, time window outside excluded, time window inside included, Velo does not match car driver, guarantee eligible=true with default driver stats (acceptance 100 cancel 0), guarantee eligible=false when acceptance threshold unreachable (999), inactive guarantee excluded, fully empty config yields any_active=false. Frontend (mobile 390x844, cookie API auth): when config is active -> [data-testid=rewards-floating-btn] visible on driver home, clicking navigates to /chauffeur/rewards, DriverRewardsPage renders with [data-testid=driver-rewards-page] + [data-testid^=reward-] (Voiture card) + [data-testid^=guarantee-] + [data-testid^=guarantee-eligibility-] ('Vous etes eligible' green badge), and 'Programme de recompense' row appears in /chauffeur/profile. When all regards+guarantees are active=false: floating btn is hidden, profile row is hidden, and /chauffeur/rewards direct visit shows [data-testid=no-rewards] empty state. Full show/hide cycle confirmed.

minor.issue: Non-driver callers (e.g. admin) get 404 'Driver profile not found' instead of 403 forbidden — acceptable fall-through, but semantically 403 would be cleaner to indicate role mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL compile error: file ended with duplicate '</AuthProvider></BrowserRouter>);}export default App;' trailing block AFTER the real 'export default App;' (lines 331-336). Babel threw SyntaxError 'Unexpected token (331:3)' and the entire frontend was serving a 'Compiled with problems' error screen. FIXED by T1.
Missing <Route path="/chauffeur/rewards" element={<DriverRewardsPage/>} /> despite the import at line 61 and the request to add the route. FIXED by T1 (added right after /chauffeur/profile route).

If a guarantee doc is missing acceptance_rate or max_cancellation, chip renders literally 'Acceptation >= undefined%' / 'Annulation <= undefined%'. Observed once when test/admin config mutated the guarantee without those keys. Low-priority hardening.

action_items: (Already fixed by T1) Remove duplicate trailing JSX after 'export default App;' in App.js and add <Route path="/chauffeur/rewards"> — main agent should double-check App.js tail diff.
(Optional hardening) In DriverRewardsPage.js, guard acceptance_rate / max_cancellation / bonus_per_trip with '?? 0' so malformed admin config doesn't render 'undefined' in chip labels.
(Optional) Return 403 (not 404) from /api/drivers/my-active-rewards when caller has no driver profile, to distinguish role-mismatch from missing resource.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js had a broken build: 'export default App;' appeared twice with dangling JSX between them — a PR sanity check (eslint no-unreachable / build compile step) would have caught this before ship.

drivers.py _vehicle_matches uses 'any(a in vt for a in aliases)' with 2-letter aliases like 'sb'/'bike' — possible false positives (e.g. vehicle_type 'subaru' matches 'sb' voiture, 'bike-courier' matches both moto AND velo). Consider exact-match or word-boundary check.

drivers.py _in_time_window accepts missing start/end by coalescing to '00:00'/'23:59' which is 24h by default — documented behaviour, but admin UX should warn when fields empty so regard is not unintentionally 24/7.
get_my_active_rewards imports get_rewards_config inside the function (local import) — fine for circular-import avoidance, but a comment would help future readers.
DriverRewardsPage.js uses credentials:'include' raw fetch without the shared axios 401-refresh interceptor (same pattern flagged in iter50). Unify with api client.
DriverHome.js polls my-active-rewards every 60s but also on every mount — no debounce if user toggles offline/online quickly. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 UI flows: active-state btn visible, navigation to rewards page, vehicle+guarantee+eligibility cards, profile row visible, inactive-state btn hidden, inactive-state profile row hidden, inactive-state empty state on rewards page)

seed_data_creation: Tests use admin PUT /api/admin/rewards/config to toggle active/inactive state. Each test has autouse _restore_config fixture that restores the original default config after every test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rewards active endpoint + conditional UI verified end-to-end. IMPORTANT: T1 repaired /app/frontend/src/App.js which had a blocking compile error (trailing duplicate JSX) and was missing the /chauffeur/rewards route — both fixed. After fix, BASE responded 200 and app compiled cleanly. Key testids: rewards-floating-btn (DriverHome), driver-rewards-page, reward-{id}, guarantee-{id}, guarantee-eligibility-{id}, no-rewards, back-btn (DriverRewardsPage). To test show/hide, use admin PUT /api/admin/rewards/config with all regard_vehicles[*].active=false and guarantees[*].active=false (or a single one active=true to show). DriverHome polls my-active-rewards every 60s; DriverProfilePage fetches once on mount. Default driver stats: acceptance_rate=100, cancellation_rate=0 (eligible for standard 80%/10% thresholds).
rca of the issue: App.js had two `export default App;` statements with residual JSX (</AuthProvider></BrowserRouter>);}) in between — likely a copy/paste error by the previous agent while adding the /chauffeur/rewards route. This caused a hard Babel SyntaxError which crashed the entire SPA ('Compiled with problems: Unexpected token (331:3)'). Additionally, the Route for /chauffeur/rewards was never added despite DriverRewardsPage being imported — so even if App.js compiled, clicking the Recompenses button would have landed on a blank/404 route. Fix: removed the duplicate trailing block and inserted <Route path="/chauffeur/rewards" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={['driver']}><DriverRewardsPage/></ProtectedRoute>} /> right after the /chauffeur/profile route. Frontend recompiled 200, and all active/inactive UI flows verified green.
